description: US business bankruptcy cases by industry label or key (Hotels, Retail, real-estate, etc.). Individual debtors and adversary proceedings (lawsuits) are omitted unless include_individuals or include_adversary is true. start_date and end_date are inclusive calendar days (YYYY-MM-DD). When a date is set, total is the full match count and skip (or offset) pages past limit (max 100). Paid.

end_date.description: Filed on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive through the end of that day.

include_individuals.description: Include individual debtors. Default false (business filings only).

limit.description: Max rows in this page (1-100). Default 25.

skip.description: Rows to skip. Alias: offset. skip wins when both are set.

start_date.description: Filed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive of that whole day.

name: get_cases_by_industry_tool
